statement: The function returns a result r and: (a) if there exists an index i with 0 <= i < len(nums) and i mod 10 == nums[i], then 0 <= r < len(nums), r mod 10 == nums[r], and for every j with 0 <= j < r, j mod 10 != nums[j]; (b) if no such index i exists, then r == -1.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and len(nums) <= 100 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 9.

statement: The function returns a result r (it does not fail).
